correctness.rationale: Normalize with w=(z-p)/(1-pz), c=(1-p²)A. Affinely transformed G_c=1/w−c log|w| has Wirtinger Jacobian |w|^(−4)(1+Re(cw))>0 for |c|<1. Each |w|=r maps once to a circle centered at −c log r, radius 1/r; the strict nesting inequality |c|log(r2/r1)<1/r1−1/r2 gives global univalence and exterior-disk range. Internal Beltrami modulus |c|r/(2|1+cw/2|) has essential supremum s/(2−s). The glued exterior reciprocal 1/w is conformal and matches the unit-circle boundary, attaining this norm, whereas any extension must match the interior. Therefore the threshold follows exactly, including k=0 and p=0; when s≥1 no k<1 qualifies. All domain and orientation hypotheses reconstructed.
